headline: Floor Boss's coin-flip gate pinned to 96/96
lede: The Floor Boss play gate had been failing about half its runs (#2774) with a repeating TypeError and a different failure set every time. Three root causes — all in the harness, none in the game: the test's own rig bot lacked the facing field the knee planner now requires, the duel leg's freight timing was random dice until a sim sweep found a seed that lands on schedule, and the full-shift cascades were testing fired-night luck instead of mechanics. The gate is deterministic now: 96/96 three times running, and the mutant reproduces the issue's exact old signature.

notes.text: The teach rig was teaching the old knee: since the #2711 knee law banned mouth-plugs outright, its escape list is deterministically empty at that floor — the leg now asserts the honest fallback (knee silent, robots walking), the same doctrine the check sibling already follows. The rig bot also lacked the `face` field #2738 made mandatory: bfsKnee threw every robot tick and the leg's paint loop died mid-suite.

Duel leg pinned to seed 189 after a Node sweep over the sim (240 floors) showed the named-till ceremony lands freight on tick 1207 there, and pumps now count in absolute world ticks (#1877's law) — per-poll counting under-counts whenever a poll runs late. The night-WON cascade is forced so every assertion tests mechanics, not fortune.
Page-error logging prints stack frames now. String(e) losing them is exactly why this flake's failure sets shifted run to run — the raw message alone pointed at nothing.
Proof both ways: three consecutive 96/96 runs, the whole check suite green, and removing the rig's face field reddens the gate at 94/96 with the issue's exact historical signature.
